acceptance: A root-owned, manual, serial post-order pilot is recorded for the validation-fixtures vertical slice.
The pilot aligns each target component only from its owned evidence, then reconciles validation-fixtures only from its own evidence and final immediate-child as-is.md records.
Root coordination does not edit child as-is.md records, and child implementation, tests, task narratives, transcripts, and grandchildren are not parent semantic inputs.
The manual pilot does not invoke implementing-component-tasks or building-components as execution procedures.
The root task hands bounded pilot evidence to the skills-owned reconciling-as-is-records decision without claiming or creating a new skill prematurely.

The completed validation-fixtures twig demonstrates named diagram headings, at least one diagram per record, interactive immediate-child diagram links with Components-table Markdown fallback, contextual Links without changelog entries or unrelated duplicate-navigation catalogs, routine code/test links only under an explicit exception, and experimental trimmed as-is-rooted breadcrumbs only within that twig; no later twig begins before user review.
